import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int T = 14;
    static long up;

    static long qp(long a, long b) {
        long x = 1;
        a %= MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) x = (x * a) % MOD;
            a = (a * a) % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return x;
    }

    static class LinearSeq {
        int m;
        long[] a = new long[0];
        long[] h = new long[0];
        long[] t_ = new long[0];
        long[] s = new long[0];
        long[] t = new long[0];

        public LinearSeq(int m) {
            this.m = m;
            a = new long[m];
            h = new long[m];
            t_ = new long[2 * m];
            s = new long[m];
            t = new long[m];
        }

        void mull(long[] p, long[] q) {
            Arrays.fill(t_, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                if (p[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                        t_[i + j] = (t_[i + j] + p[i] * q[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 2 * m - 1; i >= m; i--) {
                if (t_[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                        t_[i - j - 1] = (t_[i - j - 1] + t_[i] * h[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            System.arraycopy(t_, 0, p, 0, m);
        }

        long calc(long K) {
            Arrays.fill(s, 0);
            Arrays.fill(t, 0);
            s[0] = 1;
            if (m != 1) t[1] = 1; else t[0] = h[0];

            long K_ = K;
            while (K_ > 0) {
                if ((K_ & 1) == 1) {
                    mull(s, t);
                }
                mull(t, t);
                K_ >>= 1;
            }
            long su = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                su = (su + s[i] * a[i]) % MOD;
            }
            return (su + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        int work(List<Integer> x, long n) {
            if (n < x.size()) return x.get((int) n);
            List<Integer> v = BM(x);
            m = v.size();
            if (m == 0) return 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                h[i] = v.get(i);
                a[i] = x.get(i);
            }
            return (int) calc(n);
        }

        List<Integer> BM(List<Integer> x) {
            List<Integer> ls = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Integer> cur = new ArrayList<>();
            int lf = 0;
            long ld = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
                long t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); j++) {
                    t = (t + x.get(i - j - 1) * cur.get(j)) % MOD;
                }
                if ((t - x.get(i)) % MOD == 0) continue;
                if (cur.size() == 0) {
                    cur = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i + 1, 0L));
                    lf = i;
                    ld = (t - x.get(i)) % MOD;
                    continue;
                }
                long c = - (x.get(i) - t) * qp(ld, MOD - 2) % MOD;
                List<Long> cList = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < i - lf - 1; j++) cList.add(0L);
                cList.add(c);
                for (int j = 0; j < ls.size(); j++) {
                    cList.add(-ls.get(j) * c % MOD);
                }
                while (cList.size() < cur.size()) cList.add(0L);
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); j++) {
                    cList.set(j, (cList.get(j) + cur.get(j)) % MOD);
                }
                if (i - lf + ls.size() >= cur.size()) {
                    ls = new ArrayList<>(cur);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = (t - x.get(i)) % MOD;
                }
                cur = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Long val : cList) {
                    cur.add((val % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
                }
            }
            return ls;
        }
    }

    static long check(long n) {
        long ans = 0;
        String st = Long.toString(n);
        int len = st.length();
        if (n > 0) ans++;
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long cur = 1, num = n;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < i; j++) {
                cur *= 10;
            }
            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) num *= 10;
            if (i < len) {
                String pref = st.substring(0, i);
                num = Long.parseLong(pref);
                num++;
            }
            if (num > up) num = up;
            if (num > cur) ans += num - cur;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        n++;
        up = n;
        long part = (n % MOD) * ((n / MOD1) + 2) % MOD;
        part = MOD - part;

        long ans = 0;
        for (long i = -n / MOD1 - 1; i <= n / MOD1 + 1; i++) {
            long cur = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
                long L = 0, R = 1;
                if (j >= 1) {
                    L = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k + 1 < j; k++) {
                        L *= 10;
                    }
                    R = L * 10;
                }
                if (R > n) R = n;
                long lastr = R;
                if (L < R) {
                    L--;
                    while (R - L > 1) {
                        long mid = (L + R) / 2;
                        if (check(mid) > mid + MOD1 * i - 1) R = mid;
                        else L = mid;
                    }
                    cur += lastr - R;
                }
            }
            ans += cur;
        }
        ans %= MOD;
        ans = (-(ans + part % MOD) % MOD) * MOD1;
        ans %= MOD;
        System.out.println((MOD + ans % MOD) % MOD);
    }
}
